texts.facts: Petitioner imported raw betel nuts (arecanuts) as per Ext.P2 invoice. The second respondent did not release the goods for the reason that consignment should be satisfied with food standard clearance under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 (for short, the "FSS Act"). Petitioner relies on Ext.P6, an import release order issued in accordance with the provisions of the Plant Quarantine (Regulation of Import into India) Order, 2003 and issued under Sub-section (1) of Section 3 of the Destructive Insects & Pest Act, 1914. Ext.P6 indicates that consignment has been recommended for release. the consignment, even after undergoing some other processes cannot be made fit for human consumption.
